title: DRAWING LIST AND LOCATION, VICINITY AND SITE MAPS
summary: Full 43x30 in sheet. Schedule of Drawings for the complete USACE set: Sheets 1-42 structural/civil (channel crossing, north fixed spans, bascule span, bascule substructure, sector, counterweight, bascule leaf, south fixed span, mechanical room, timber decks, Tilden Way relocation), 43-49 Tilden Way, 50-59 Mechanical, 60-75 Electrical, plus 12A, 52A-52F (bridge operating machinery), 57A-57C (trunnion hanger modification), 76-78 (debris removal hoist, barrier fence). A 'Fruitvale Avenue Railroad Bridge' 14-sheet list is struck DELETED. A separate 'Modification Drawings to Miller-Sweeney Highway Bridge' list has 4 sheets (2-6-68): vicinity/location/electrical plan; stabilizer bracket and stabilizer strut bushing; dolphin access ladders; pier fender access ladder. Location map, vicinity map, site map with project limits (Alameda Approach, Channel Crossing; Oakland Approach not in contract). Note: bridge name changed to Miller-Sweeney Highway Bridge. Revision 4 'As Constructed - Changes made' 75 JUL 14.
notes: Page stored rotated 270 deg; PyMuPDF renders upright. Sheet 12 title appears amended by hand to 'North Fixed Spans - Pier 10+00.00' and 12A 'Pier 10+97.50' — confirm on those sheets. Modification drawings (stabilizer strut bushing) are directly relevant to the counterweight strut scope item.
